ctx.x: -- than if I had been out, you know, outside. So naturally I knew about all these guys, I knew all of them, you know. I knew all the saxaphone players, I knew Ross Gorman, big names like that, Chester Hazlett; they were virtuosos, you know, those cats were technical, great saxaphone players. But Frankie and Bix played the jazz.
